newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares traded despite official close.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares traded despite official close.

text.p: Shenzhen's B shares were traded due to a technical hitch on Friday morning when the market was officially closed in line with the Hong Kong stock market's Easter holiday, exchange officials said on Monday.
On Friday, the exchange system indicated 224,000 B shares worth HK$1.1 million ($141,000) were traded in the early morning session, pushing the index up 0.42 points to 162.56 points.
"Dealers traded and we have to validate the transactions," an exchange official said but declined to give further details.
Friday's transactions would be carried over to Tuesday when trading is due to resume, an exchange statement in Monday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
"Because of technical reasons, the B share trade on March 28 is effective, and will be included in the next trading day," the statement said but gave no details.
Dealers said they did not know who traded on Friday.
